families.no-foil: Common = the bare sprite, no background (user rule); Uncommon / Rare = muted matte scene (sprite-scale blocks / grid scale), plain frame, rarity symbol
families.reverse: the art stays matte; a 5px foil ring outside it carries the pattern
families.holo-in-art: matte frame, foil pattern inside the art window, vertical light bar
families.V-family: framed art with textured foil and a diagonal rainbow beam pair (sunpillar)
families.old-era: LV.X streaks, Prime spiked window, LEGEND split card, BREAK gold square prism
families.prism-star: crystal / prism facets, star emblems, shiny sprites for Shining and Gold Star
families.shiny: the colorscripts SHINY sprite on sparkle / glitter foil
families.amazing: rainbow paint splash bursting out through the frame
families.radiant: radial crosshatch burst from the Pokemon, shiny sprite
families.etched-full-art: full bleed, fingerprint contour lines, rainbow wave along the lines
families.special-illustration: full painting with a pearlescent sweep (and the new pop-art / chrome specials)
families.rainbow: pastel rainbow gradient + etched lines, rainbow frame
families.gold: gold ramp foil (engraved / studs / crystalline / dense etch) + glitter, gold frame
families.monochrome: black or white embossed card, colour only in the moving holo
